title: Add the missing quest-managed CLAUDE.md block
summary: quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude reports the quest agent instruction block is missing entirely (not drifted -- this repo's CLAUDE.md never had one, only the lore:agents managed block). Surfaced while checking for drift after the user installed lore 0.4.6 and quest 0.4.0. No CI install pin for lore/quest exists in this repo's workflows to bump (checked: none found). Run quest agents --update-instructions --target claude and confirm the check reads current.
finalSummary: quest agents --update-instructions --target claude added the missing quest:agent-instructions managed block to CLAUDE.md and generated .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md, matching the existing .claude/skills/lore/ pattern (this repo's own operational tracker skill, separate from the opum-sdlc/opum-handoff plugin content it publishes). quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude now exits 0. No CI install pin for lore/quest exists in this repo's workflows -- confirmed none to bump.
